title: Ijwi Rirwanya Ibiremereye vy'Ikinyoma
intro: Umutima w’umwizigirwa warakuriye mu bacuruzi n’abadandaza mu gihugu aho umunzane wari uhengamiye, ingero zigacishwa bugufi. Uwo muntu yari ahagaze wenyene arwanya ubuhemu bw’ihanga ryose, akabahamagara ku butungane no gusenga Imana imwe y’ukuri. Naho ubutumwa bwari butomoye kandi n’uguhamagara kwari gutunganye, abantu banse kwumviriza maze bashikirwa n’ivyago biteye ubwoba. Woba ushobora kumenya iyo ntumwa y’icubahiro ivuye muri Korowani?
clues: Narungitswe nk’intumwa ku bantu ubuzima bwabo bwari bushingiye ku bucuruzi n’ubudandaji.
Abantu banje bari bazwi mu gihugu cose mu gutanga ingero ngufi no guhenda mu bipimo.
Baratera ubwoba kandi abagenzi mu nzira, bagakwiragiza ibiturire kw’isi yose.
Nabahimiriza gusenga Allah wenyene no kuba abanyakuri bimwe bishitse mu migenderanire bafitaniye n’abandi.
Banse ubutumwa bwanje, bantera ubwoba bwo kwirukana mu gihugu jewe n’abo twari bemeranye.
Allah yarakijije jewe n’abayoboke banje ku mbabazi ziwe, mu gihe abanyavyaha bafatwa n’igihano gikomeye.

trial.label: Icaha c'abantu banje
options: Kubaka umunara muremure uhagaze ku kirere .

arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَـٰرِهِمْ جَـٰثِمِينَ
verse: And when Our command came, We saved Shuʿayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone (11:94)
